CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION get_pending_verifications(user_uuid uuid) RETURNS TABLE (id uuid, type text, title text, description text, resolved_at timestamp with time zone). LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER. No search_path set in this version (fixed in next migration). Behavior: returns UNION ALL of (a) rows from issue_reports where reported_by = user_uuid AND needs_user_verification = true AND verification_status = 'pending', emitting type='issue', title='Issue Report', ir.description, ir.resolved_at; and (b) rows from suggestions where reported_by = user_uuid AND needs_user_verification = true AND verification_status = 'pending', emitting type='suggestion', s.title, s.description, s.resolved_at. Tables touched: issue_reports (read), suggestions (read).
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION get_pending_verifications TO authenticated;
DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS get_pending_verifications(uuid); — dropped to fix security warning (missing search_path), recreated immediately below in same migration.

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION normalize_inspection_json_data() RETURNS void LANGUAGE plpgsql (no SECURITY clause = SECURITY INVOKER, no search_path set). One-off data-migration function: iterates all inspections rows with json_data IS NOT NULL AND template_id IS NOT NULL; detects 'numeric key' format (top-level jsonb keys matching '^[0-9]+$'); for those, looks up inspection_templates.sections by template_id and, when sections is a jsonb array, rebuilds json_data keyed by template section 'id' and item 'id' strings instead of array indexes; preserves top-level keys 'tenants', 'observations', 'siteDrawingPdf', 'siteDrawingPins', 'siteDrawingCanvas'; then UPDATE inspections SET json_data = normalized_data WHERE id = insp_record.id. RAISE NOTICE progress messages. Tables touched: inspections (read+update), inspection_templates (read).

SELECT normalize_inspection_json_data(); — executes the one-off backfill, rewriting inspections.json_data in place from numeric (array-index) keys to template-defined string section/item ids for every inspection with a template_id and numeric-format json_data. Matters because all later readers of json_data assume string keys.
DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS normalize_inspection_json_data(); — function removed after the one-off run; it does not exist in the final schema.
